steps.instruction: Chill 4 1/4 cups of water in the fridge until it is very cold.
steps.spoken: Chill 4 1/4 cups of water in the fridge until it is very cold. You can also add ice to make it colder.

steps.instruction: Put the cold water and 1 cup of oats in a blender.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 teaspoons of peanut butter.
Blend on high speed for 15 seconds.
Pour the oat milk through cheesecloth.
